THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, DECEMBER 18, 1936
（印：…）

Dr. O. Fischer Returns
From European Journey

Dr. O. Fischer, well-known
Shanghai attorney and partner of
the legal firm of Musso, Fischer
and Wilhelm, has returned to
Shanghai after an absence of more
than three months. He arrived in
the city two days ago, coming from
the North, having made the return
trip to China via Siberia.
The attorney left Shanghai early
in September and while away visited
most of the capitals of Europe in
connection with his firm's business.
He spent considerable time in
Italy.
While in Rome, Dr. Fischer was
received by Count Ciano, now
Italian Foreign Minister and
formerly Minister of China. He
also was met by Comm. Boscarelli,
another former Italian Minister to
China, who is now Il Duce's repre-
sentative in Greece.

（批：…）

《字林西报》，1936年12月18日，星期五
（印：…）

O. Fischer 博士结束欧洲之行归来

O. Fischer 博士是上海知名律师，也是 Musso, Fischer and Wilhelm 律师事务所的合伙人。在离家三个多月后，他已返回上海。他于两天前抵达本市，自北方而来，经西伯利亚踏上返华归途。

这位律师于九月初离开上海，在外期间因事务所业务之故，走访了欧洲大多数首都。他在意大利度过了相当长的时间。

在罗马期间，Fischer 博士受到齐亚诺伯爵（Count Ciano，现任意大利外交大臣，前任驻华公使）的接见。他还会晤了博斯卡雷利上校（Comm. Boscarelli，另一位前任意大利驻华公使，现为墨索里尼元首驻希腊代表）。

CONFIDENTIAL

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 9, 1934

Dr. O. Fischer of Messrs. Musso,
Fischer & Wilhelm, returned yester-
day in the ss. Dairen Maru from
Dairen after a short business trip to
Europe. Dr. Fischer left here at the
end of August going to Singapore in
an Italian vessel and then flying home
by the Royal Dutch Airmail com-
pleting 8,000 miles in six days. Dr.
Fischer returned via the U.S.S.R. and
Siberia.

D.S. S.S. &
Information.

CONFIDENTIAL

S. 2. Special Branch.
March 20, 1933.
Letters from Willi Muenzenberg addressed to Harold
R. Isaacs; Dr. Fischer and Dr. Wilhelm.

Attached herewith are photographic copies of three
letters from Willi Muenzenberg addressed to Harold Isaacs,
Dr. Fischer and Dr. Wilhelm, the originals of which were
enclosed in an envelope addressed to Harold Isaacs. The
contents of these missives are, briefly, as follows :-
(1) Letter in English dated Paris January 20, 1933, from Willi
Muenzenberg, (President ?) of the "Comite International pour
la Defense de Paul et Gertrud Ruegg", addressed to Harold
Isaacs, Shanghai. The writer thanks Isaacs for his active
interest in the Ruegg (Noulens) case and informs him that a
new hunger-strike campaign has been started. Muenzenberg
also states he encloses copies of specially addressed
letters to Dr. Fischer and Dr. Wilhelm respectively
regarding a certain sum of money retained by them.
He concludes by stating that Chinese officials in Europe
spread all kinds of rumours concerning the excellent
conditions prevailing in Chinese prisons, and that in this
connection the "Gertrud and Paul Ruegg Defence Committee"
were publishing a report of a Chinese who had fled from
the "hell" of Chinese prisons.
(2) Letter in German dated January 16, 1933 from the President
(Willi Muenzenberg ?) addressed to Dr. Fischer requesting
information as to how the sum of G$1,500, which had been
deposited in the American Oriental Bank by Ruegg (Noulens),
had been expended.
(3) Letter in German dated January 16, 1933 from the President

威利·明岑贝格（Willi Muenzenberg）致哈罗德·R·艾萨克斯（Harold R. Isaacs）、费舍尔博士（Dr. Fischer）和威廉博士（Dr. Wilhelm）的信件。

随函附上威利·明岑贝格致哈罗德·艾萨克斯、费舍尔博士和威廉博士的三封信件的摄影复制件，这些信件的原件曾装在一个写给哈罗德·艾萨克斯的信封中。这些信函的内容简述如下：-
(1) 英文信，日期为1933年1月20日，地点巴黎，由“保尔和格特鲁德·吕埃格国际辩护委员会”（Comite International pour la Defense de Paul et Gertrud Ruegg）主席（？）威利·明岑贝格发出，收件人为上海哈罗德·艾萨克斯。写信人感谢艾萨克斯对吕埃格（努兰斯）案件的积极关注，并告知他一场新的绝食抗议运动已经开始。明岑贝格还称，他附上了分别致费舍尔博士和威廉博士的专函副本，内容涉及由他们扣留的某笔款项。他在信末指出，在欧洲的中国官员散布各种谣言，称中国监狱内条件优越，为此，“格特鲁德和保尔·吕埃格辩护委员会”正在出版一份报告，内容是一名从中国监狱“地狱”中逃脱的中国人的陈述。
(2) 德文信，日期为1933年1月16日，由主席（威利·明岑贝格？）发出，收件人为费舍尔博士，要求说明吕埃格（努兰斯）存入美国东方银行（American Oriental Bank）的1,500元规元（G$1,500）是如何支出的。
(3) 德文信，日期为1933年1月16日，由主席（威利·明岑贝格？）发出，收件人为威廉博士，要求说明吕埃格夫人（范德克鲁伊森）交由其支配的一笔款项是如何处置的。
这些摄影复制件系公共租界警务处从法国警察处收到。

Dear friend,

I thank you for your letter of the
5th December. Our Committee has taken
notice with the greatest interest of your
report about the latest news in the Ruegg
case. We have started a new campaign of
the hunger strike. Please inform hereabout
the respective members of the Shanghai
Committee.

I have written special letters to
Dr. Fischer and Dr. Wilhelm about the
sums retained, copies of which I enclose.
A special delegation has been sent to Mr.
Wellington Koo at Geneva. As soon as I
get his answer, I immediately shall transfer
it to you.

The Chinese officials in Europe
spread all kinds of rumors about excellent
conditions in Chinese prisons. It will
be an easy task for you, through your
newspapers show all the lies of their
declarations. We are publishing in the
next days a report of a Chinese friend who
fled from the hell of Chinese prisons.

With best greetings,

Yours

Willi Muenzenberg.

Translation from German

16/1/33
To Dr. Fischer
Shanghai
Sir,
    As I have been informed by our representative, Mr. Vincent, who
returned to Europe, Mr. Ruegg, at the time of his arrest, transferred
to Dr. Wilhelm the sum of G.$1500.00 which was deposited in the
American Oriental Bank. Will you please let me know for what
purposes this sum was expended. I have been informed from another
source that this sum was detained by the authorities concerned and
was recently distributed among the judges, police and guards. If
there was no court order for the confiscation of the above sum,
this must be considered a sheer robbery on the part of the Chinese
authorities, and I request you to lodge a strong protest against this
action on behalf of our Defence Committee.
    Mr. Ruegg, I am informed, signed an order in the beginning of
December, according to which the sum of approximately G.$1500.00
was transferred in favour of the Defence Committee. I should be
very much obliged to you, if you would furnish me with information
on this subject.
    Please hand the enclosed letter to Dr. Wilhelm, your partner.

                                I am, Sir, etc.
                                    President.

1 letter enclosed.

1933年1月16日
致费希尔博士 (Dr. Fischer)
上海
先生：
    据我方代表文森特先生（Mr. Vincent）告知，他已返回欧洲。吕格先生（Mr. Ruegg）在被捕时，将存入美国东方银行（American Oriental Bank）的规元1500.00元移交给了威廉博士（Dr. Wilhelm）。请告知我这笔款项用于何种目的。我从另一渠道获悉，这笔款项被有关当局扣留，并最近在法官、警察和看守之间进行了分配。如果上述款项的没收没有法院命令，则必须将此视为中国当局的纯粹抢劫行为，我请求您代表我们的辩护委员会对此行动提出强烈抗议。
    据我得知，吕格先生于12月初签署了一项命令，据此将约规元1500.00元的款项转让给辩护委员会。如蒙您提供有关此事的信息，我将不胜感激。
    请将随信附上的信件转交给您的合伙人威廉博士。

                                此致，等等。
                                    主席

附信1封。

CONFIDENTIAL.

REPORT ON Dr. Oskar S. Fischer.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by Thos Robertson, C.D.1.

Dr. Oskar S. Fischer is 50 years of age and is an Austrian Jew
having been born in the province of Tyrol when it was Austrian
territory. Arriving in Shanghai about 1907 or 1911 he was
employed for some time as a fur broker with the Austro-Asiatic
Trading Coy. On April 10, 1913 he married a French lady and
there are two sons of the marriage; Raoul aged 15, and George
aged 14, both of whom are being educated in Germany. After
leaving the Austro-Asiatic Trading Coy. Dr. Fischer was for some
time editor of a French newspaper and in the years 1914, 1915
and part of 1916 he was manager of the China Export and Import
(dealing in furs etc.,) at 112 Szechuen Road. In addition to
the latter business he practised as a Barrister-at-Law and signed
the Lawyers Roll of the old Mixed Court on June 14, 1915. For
one or two years, however, he was not very successful and found
great difficulty in maintaining a livelihood. In the autumn
of 1916 the China Export and Import Coy. went out of business
and he opened his own lawyers office at 112 Szechuen Road where,
while not too successful he became better known by his capabil-
ities as a lawyer. In 1919 he closed his office to join the
law firm of Mr. Russo and was a member of the staff until 1921
when he was admitted into partnership and the firm became known
as Russo and Fischer.

During the Great War Dr. Fischer registered as an
enemy subject and was known as a notorious pro-German and a
helper of German interests ever since the outbreak of hostilities.

Soon after the Great War broke out he tried to register at the
French Consulate but was unsuccessful and in February 1919 he

关于奥斯卡·S·菲舍尔博士（Dr. Oskar S. Fischer）的报告。

由 D. I. Robertson 撰写。经刑事侦缉一队（C.D.1）托马斯·罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）转呈。

奥斯卡·S·菲舍尔博士现年50岁，系奥地利犹太人，出生于当时尚属奥地利领土的蒂罗尔省（Tyrol）。他约于1907年或1911年抵达上海，曾在奥亚贸易公司（Austro-Asiatic Trading Coy.）担任皮草经纪人一段时间。1913年4月10日，他与一位法国女士结婚，婚后育有二子：拉乌尔（Raoul），15岁；乔治（George），14岁，二人均在德国接受教育。离开奥亚贸易公司后，菲舍尔博士曾担任一家法文报纸的编辑一段时间；在1914年、1915年及1916年的部分时间里，他担任位于四川路112号的中国进出口公司（China Export and Import，经营皮草等业务）的经理。除上述业务外，他还以律师身份执业，并于1915年6月14日在旧会审公廨的律师名册上签字注册。然而，在一两年间，他的境况并不十分顺利，维持生计颇为艰难。1916年秋，中国进出口公司停业，他在四川路112号开设了自己的律师事务所，虽然生意不算太成功，但其作为律师的才能逐渐为人所知。1919年，他关闭事务所，加入鲁索先生（Mr. Russo）的律师事务所，成为其职员直至1921年；当年他获准成为合伙人，该律所遂更名为“鲁索与菲舍尔”（Russo and Fischer）。

大战期间，菲舍尔博士登记为敌国侨民，且自战事爆发以来，即以著名的亲德分子及德国利益协助者而闻名。

大战爆发后不久，他曾试图在法国领事馆登记，但未获成功；1919年2月，他

registered at the Local Italian Consulate; since the province of
Tyrol was ceded to Italy after the war he automatically became
an Italian subject.

In his career as a barrister he has been mixed up in
one or two shady legal transactions and it may be said that where
business is concerned he has no scruples.

In June 1925 it was reported that relations of a very
cordial nature existed between the firm of Russo and Fischer and
the representative of the Soviet Government in China. At the same
time it was also reported that the Soviet Minister in Peking
paid Dr. Fischer large sums for propaganda purposes. The employment
of the latter on several occasions by the Soviet to appear
in cases arising out of the sale of ships of the Russian Volunteer
Fleet afforded corroboration of the foregoing statement.
Also, at the time of the departure of the Soviet authorities,
by order of the Nanking authorities, from China in December 1927
Dr. Fischer was most active in looking after Soviet interests and
in consequence became known as the "Soviet Lawyer". On June 15,
1928 Dr. Fischer left Shanghai ostensibly on a trip to Europe
via Siberia. Information was received however that he left on
a diplomatic mission to Moscow to report the result of his negotiations
with the Nationalist Government on behalf of the Soviet
authorities regarding the possibility of China ports being opened
to vessels of the Soviet Mercantile Fleet and if possible to
bring about a successful conclusion of the issue. He returned to
Shanghai on October 30, 1928.

在其律师职业生涯中，他曾卷入一两起不光彩的法律交易，可以说在商业事务上他毫无顾忌。

1925年6月，有报告称 Russo and Fischer 律师事务所与苏联政府驻华代表之间存在着非常融洽的关系。同时亦有报告称，苏联驻北京公使为宣传目的向费舍尔博士（Dr. Fischer）支付了巨额款项。苏联方面曾多次雇用后者出庭处理因出售俄国志愿舰队（Russian Volunteer Fleet）船只而引发的案件，这佐证了上述说法。此外，1927年12月，当苏联当局奉南京当局之命撤离中国时，费舍尔博士最为积极地维护苏联利益，因此被称为“苏联律师”。1928年6月15日，费舍尔博士离开上海，表面上是经西伯利亚前往欧洲旅行。然而收到情报称，他是作为外交使团前往莫斯科，代表苏联当局向苏方汇报其与国民政府就苏联商船队船只开放中国港口一事进行谈判的结果，并尽可能促成该问题的圆满解决。他于1928年10月30日返回上海。

SECRET

H. B. M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
20th. May, 1929.

My dear Aiers,

The Authorities in India suggest that
the well-known local lawyer Dr. O. Fischer who applied
to H.B.M Supreme Court for permission to defend the
accused in the case of the murder of Harcharan Singh,
may be identical with an Austrian lawyer and merchant
named Dr. O. Fischer who, according to a statement
made early in 1917 in connection with Indian sedition
in the Far East, was one of the principal men who were
engaged in plots against India at that time. I should
be glad to have your views on this suggestion and to
have a detailed report on the Italian lawyer, Dr. O.
Fischer, if this can be compiled without giving your
staff a great deal of trouble. The Authorities in
India also suggest that Dr. O. Fischer may now be an
Italian citizen owing to the transfer after the war of
a portion of Austrian territory to Italy.

Yours sincerely,
C. H. K. Halliday.

R. C. Aiers, Esq.,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

亲爱的艾尔斯（Aiers）：

印度当局建议，那位向英国在华最高法院申请许可在哈尔查兰·辛格（Harcharan Singh）谋杀案中为被告辩护的本地知名律师 O. 费舍尔博士（Dr. O. Fischer），可能与一位名为 O. 费舍尔博士（Dr. O. Fischer）的奥地利律师兼商人系同一人；根据1917年初一份关于远东印度煽动叛乱活动的陈述，此人是当时从事反印度阴谋活动的主要人物之一。如能在不给贵处职员造成过多麻烦的情况下编制一份关于这位意大利律师 O. 费舍尔博士的详细报告，我将很高兴听取您对此建议的看法。印度当局还指出，由于战后部分奥地利领土转移给意大利，O. 费舍尔博士现在可能已是意大利公民。

此致
敬礼，

C. H. K. 哈利迪（Halliday）。

R. C. 艾尔斯（Aiers）先生，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D. REGISTRY
No. L.O. 9250
Date 18.6.31

June 18, 3

Dear

With reference to the attached copy of a newspaper
article regarding Dr. A. Fischer, information has been received
that he has departed on a diplomatic mission to Moscow. Prior
to his leaving Shanghai he negotiated with the Nationalist
authorities on behalf of the Soviet Government regarding the
possibility of Chinese ports being opened to vessels of the
Soviet Mercantile Fleet and his visit to Moscow is to report
the result of his work and if possible to bring about a
successful conclusion of the issue.

Yours sincerely,

he

Letters sent to :-
W.C. Cassels, Esq., H.B.M. Consulate General
Lieut. Col. G.H.R. Halland, O.B.E., North China Command.
Lieut. F. Goldsmith, North China Command.

编号 L.O. 9250
日期 1931年6月18日

1931年6月18日

亲爱的

关于所附有关 A. 费舍尔博士（Dr. A. Fischer）的报纸文章副本，已收到情报称，他已启程前往莫斯科执行外交任务。在离开上海之前，他代表苏联政府与国民政府当局进行了谈判，商讨苏联商船队船只开放中国港口的可能性，他此次访问莫斯科旨在汇报其工作成果，并尽可能促成该问题的圆满解决。

此致
敬礼，

he
